title: Tequila Mockingbird Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the heart of it all, Tequila Mockingbird is a 1 bedroom condo right above Seaside's iconic Modica Market overlooking the town and the beautiful emerald coast!
description_expanded: COMPLETE RENOVATION! All new furnishings throughout, and gorgeous kitchen and bath remodel have made Tequlia Mockingbird STUNNING! Pics coming SOON! Ready for April 2026 rentals! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ON Seaside square and ocean views from balcony and building common space - Across the street from the beach with access to George and Coleman pavilions in Seaside - Up to 3 Wrist Bands TOTAL for private beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) - KING bed, pull-out sofa most suitable for 1 child - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Fully stocked kitchen for all your cooking needs - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). Located in the heart of it all, Tequila Mockingbird is a 1-bedroom condo right above Seaside's iconic Modica Market overlooking the town and the beautiful emerald coast! Tequila Mockingbird is a 2-story condo with an oversized king master bedroom with private bath and flat screen TV on the main level with WIFI internet access. The master bath offers a gorgeous, oversized shower. Up a spiral staircase the condo offers open living and dining spaces, new, soft and neutral decor and gorgeous private balcony views. The designer kitchen has stainless appliances, a sub zero fridge, bar seating for two and a dining table that seats two more. The living room has a sleeper sofa, additional seating and flat screen TV as well. A private balcony completes the upper level and offers the best views in the condo. Kick back and enjoy the sunset over the gulf from the comfort of Tequila Mockingbird! ACCOMODATIONS: Main Floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, custom bedding, Flat screen TV, custom built in cabinetry, private en-suite 2026 renovated bathroom with large shower Hallway half bath Second Floor up the spiral staircase Sleeper sofa in living area (most suitable for 1 child), TV, 2026 remodeled Kitchen, small dining area and balcony with the best views overlooking the town of Seaside! IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** Please note this home does not have access to a washer/dryer ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
